articles.title: Texas Supreme Court Criminal Appeals Results Elections
articles.excerpt: Nov. 3, 2026 result: Mark Ash lost the race for Court of Criminal Appeals, Place 3 with 231,048 votes (2.4%); opponents: Thomas Smith (R) 4,601,878 (47.6%), Okey Anyiam (D) 4,839,230 (50.0%), in unofficial returns (Texas Secretary of State; The Texas Tribune).
